summary: This is a Mol Labs public research report (card P9) evaluating whether apoptosome (caspase-9/Apaf-1) loss-of-function abolishes FOXO4-DRI senolytic kill at least as completely as navitoclax kill in matched senescent cultures. The report is a pre-registered hypothesis/assay proposal with a NEGATIVE status label, meaning the key experimental evidence (matched apoptosome LOF head-to-head panel) is entirely UNKNOWN — no dedicated experiment has been run. The document synthesizes prior literature to frame the mechanistic question and defines the prediction variables, thresholds, and refutation criteria for a future experiment.

Related prior: P5–P8 (Bax LOF / residual / HN sparing ≠ apoptosome LOF proof). Document date: 2026-09-25.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis
content_blocks.content: Pre-registered claim: On a matched senescent culture, caspase-9 or Apaf-1 loss-of-function (or pharmacologic apoptosome block) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill. Quantitative threshold: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, with each arm showing ≥20% relative kill loss vs the same senolytic on control genotype/vehicle. This is a PREDICTION — no experimental data exists for this specific comparison.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax enters via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w inhibition. Both may still require the apoptosome (caspase-9/Apaf-1) for execution — or FOXO4-DRI may retain partial apoptosome-independent routes (e.g., caspase-8). Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work frames a p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade without a caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF vs navitoclax matched abolish panel. The apoptosome necessity question is distinct from P7 Bax/Bak epistasis, P8 residual under Bax LOF, and P5/P6 HN pathway-sparing. If FOXO4-DRI still needs the apoptosome ≥ navitoclax, distinct entry does not spare MOMP-execution gating.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
Four key prior art references are cited:
1. PMID 28340339 (Baar 2017, Cell, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2017.02.031, PMC5556182): FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 → senescent-cell apoptosis. No caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF arm; not Bcl-xL occupancy.
2. PMID 41625068 (2025, Front. Bioeng. Biotechnol., DOI 10.3389/fbioe.2025.1729166, PMC12852416): Endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3. Caspase-3 cascade ≠ apoptosome LOF vs navitoclax H2H.
3. PMID 26711051 (Zhu 2016, DOI 10.1111/acel.12445, PMC4854923): Navitoclax (ABT-263) senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted.
4. PMID 9708735 (Kuida 1998, DOI 10.1016/s0092-8674(00)81476-2): Mice lacking caspase-9 show reduced apoptosis and cytochrome c–mediated caspase activation. Apoptosome execution prior — not a FOXO4-DRI SC matched panel.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured vs. Claimed
content_blocks.content:
Baseline claimed: Caspase-9/Apaf-1 (apoptosome) LOF or block abolishes FOXO4-DRI SC kill ≥ navitoclax on matched SC cultures (or P7/P8 Bax framing already settles full MOMP-execution identity).

Baseline measured:
- FOXO4–p53 entry: LITERATURE (PMID 28340339)
- Downstream BCL-2/caspase-3 framing: LITERATURE without apoptosome LOF H2H (PMID 41625068)
- Navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic: LITERATURE (PMID 26711051)
- Caspase-9 KO reduces cytochrome c–mediated caspase activation: LITERATURE as execution prior (PMID 9708735)
- Matched caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish: UNKNOWN (soft-complete FOXO4-DRI∩apoptosome = 0)
- ≥ Equal abolish (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav; each ≥20% relative): PREDICTION
- P5–P8 do not already prove this epistasis.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P5–P8 as proving P9 — Bax LOF / residual / HN sparing cards did not run apoptosome LOF; empty soft-complete ≠ demonstrated ≥ equal abolish.
2. Caspase-3 cascade ≠ caspase-9 necessity — PMID 41625068 implicates caspase-3 without genetic apoptosome requirement or navitoclax-matched abolish.
3. ≥ Equal abolish is stronger than shared mitochondrial involvement — FOXO4-DRI could keep partial apoptosome-independent routes; navitoclax-insensitive SC types confound matched culture choice; Kuida is not a FOXO4-DRI panel.

content_blocks.title: Ablation / Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content:
Ablation conditions (what must not be removed):
- Matched caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF (or pharmacologic apoptosome block) contrast of FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax on the same culture: Without the H2H abolish panel, separate LITERATURE legs cannot show FOXO4-DRI kill is abolished ≥ navitoclax under apoptosome LOF.
- ≥ Equal-abolish quantitative contrast (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav): Showing both need mitochondria is weaker than the claim.
- P5–P8≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠abolish + caspase-3-framing≠caspase-9-necessity discipline.

Refutation criterion: On the pre-registered matched panel, FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF / apoptosome block while navitoclax kill is abolished, OR relative kill loss_FOXO4 is below relative kill loss_navitoclax outside the pre-registered ≥ equal band — pathway-sparing / apoptosome-independent FOXO4-DRI execution survives.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay / Method
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Recommended approach: Lock one senescent system sensitive to both senolytics, use caspase-9 or Apaf-1 LOF vs pharmacologic apoptosome-block tool, and viability + cytochrome-c/caspase readout before claiming ≥ equal abolish. Do not treat P5–P8 as proof; no dosing specified. Estimated time to refute: 4 weeks. Kill cost tier: 1 (low cost).

key_findings: The core experimental evidence (matched caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish panel) is entirely UNKNOWN — no dedicated experiment has been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN).
Soft-complete for FOXO4-DRI∩apoptosome = 0; the only caspase-related hit (PMID 41625068) describes a caspase-3 cascade, not a caspase-9/Apaf-1 LOF vs navitoclax head-to-head.

All four supporting references are literature priors, not original experimental data from this project: Baar 2017 (FOXO4-DRI mechanism), 2025 endothelial study (caspase-3 framing), Zhu 2016 (navitoclax senolytic), Kuida 1998 (caspase-9 KO).
The pre-registered quantitative threshold requires: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax AND each arm ≥20% relative kill loss vs control genotype/vehicle.
FOXO4-DRI may retain partial apoptosome-independent routes (e.g., caspase-8), which is identified as a competing outcome that would refute the claim.
P5–P8 (Bax LOF / residual / HN sparing cards) explicitly do NOT prove P9 apoptosome epistasis — these are distinct mechanistic questions.
